Elena — thanks, great questions. I put together a short MAP draft and a TPM projection workbook attached. High level proposal below; see attached NOVA_MAP_v3.pdf and TPM_projection_v2.xlsx for the tables.

Proposed MAP (high level):
- Week 0–4: Evaluation (POC) — target 5M TPM total, Redwood provides engineer support and a 30% pilot discount on API rates for 4 weeks
- Week 5–12: Pilot — target 15M TPM/month, target SLA 95th pct lat under 250ms for standard prompt; 10% committed-discount applied on month-over-month committed TPM
- Month 4–12: Production ramp — staged commits: 25M TPM/mo (month 4–6), 50M TPM/mo (month 7–9), 75M TPM/mo (month 10–12)

Discount ladder (examples):
- >=25M TPM/mo: 12% off list
- >=50M TPM/mo: 18% off list
- >=75M TPM/mo: 25% off list

Triggers and mechanics:
- Discounts are applied as invoice line-item rate reductions once a monthly commit threshold is met for two consecutive months (to avoid single-month spikes).
- If Nova signs a 12-month committed contract with the staged ramp above, we will apply an up-front onboarding credit equal to one month of the initial committed spend (applied to month 2 invoice).
- If actual usage exceeds the commit in a month, overage billed at the post-discount pay-as-you-go rate.

Next steps I propose:
1) You review the attached MAP draft and TPM sheet and confirm the month-by-month numbers you’d expect to hit for pilot and prod.
2) Ben to propose a final pricing addendum/term sheet.
3) Procurement reviews and we iterate legal redlines.

I can hop on a 30-min call tomorrow to walk through the projection if helpful.

Thanks,

Elena — following up with concrete pricing lanes that map to Jonas' MAP draft. I’m proposing two commercial options so your finance/procurement can choose the right risk profile.

Option A — Committed Ramp (recommended for predictability):
- 12-mo term with staged commitments as proposed by Jonas.
- Pricing: base rate $0.0009/token with discounts per ladder applied to the committed tiers. Example: 25M TPM => effective $0.000792/token (12% off).
- Overages billed at $0.00095/token (post-discount PAYG).
- Onboarding credit: 1x month invoice credit after first full invoice.

Option B — Pilot-first / low-commit: 
- 3-mo pilot with optional conversion to 12-mo commit. Pilot discounted 20% off list (no long-term commit).
- If Nova converts within 30 days of pilot end, we credit pilot discount back against month 1 of committed contract.

Discount accelerators / performance credits:
- If Redwood misses agreed latency SLOs for two consecutive weeks during Pilot, we will provide a service credit equal to 5% of that month’s committed invoice.

I attached a sample term sheet (Redwood_MAP_terms_summary.docx) showing how clauses map to the MAP milestones. Happy to sync with procurement.
